title.en: SK hynix discloses shareholder-return goals and Solidigm capacity review
title.zh: SK hynix 披露股东回报目标及 Solidigm 扩产评估

change.en: The November 25 Form 6-K sets out an FY2026 shareholder-return objective of about ₩100 trillion, including at least ₩30 trillion in cash dividends and at least ₩60 trillion in treasury-share purchases and cancellations. The company reported ₩99 trillion of net cash as of September 30. Its November 27 Form 6-K says Solidigm is still evaluating ways to expand capacity and has made no decision on the reported U.S. NAND facility.
change.zh: 11 月 25 日 Form 6-K 披露，FY2026 股东回报目标约 100 万亿韩元，包括至少 30 万亿韩元的现金股息及至少 60 万亿韩元的库存股购入与注销。公司披露 9 月末净现金为 99 万亿韩元。11 月 27 日 Form 6-K 称 Solidigm 仍在评估扩产方案，尚未就媒体报道的美国 NAND 工厂作出决定。

meaning.en: The return amounts are forward-looking. Solidigm’s capacity review leaves the project outside the confirmed NAND supply pipeline.
meaning.zh: 股东回报目标属于前瞻披露。供应端只有扩产方案评估，尚无可计入供应预测的项目承诺。

next.en: Check subsequent filings for cash dividends, repurchases and cancellations. SK hynix plans a follow-up when the project details firm up or within three months of November 27.
next.zh: 对照后续报表核实现金股息、回购和注销。公司将在项目细节确认时或自 11 月 27 日起三个月内再披露。

title.en: TSMC reports NT$38.8 billion of October buildings and facilities acquisitions
title.zh: 台积电披露 10 月取得新台币 388 亿元房屋及设施

change.en: The November 25 Form 6-K lists NT$38.8 billion in October buildings and facilities acquisitions by TSMC and its subsidiaries. It reports no board-approved capital appropriations for the month.
change.zh: 11 月 25 日 Form 6-K 披露，台积电及子公司 10 月取得房屋及设施共新台币 388 亿元。当月无董事会批准的资本拨款。

meaning.en: The filing documents an asset acquisition amount. Cash payment timing, equipment orders and production milestones still require separate evidence.
meaning.zh: 月度申报列出资产取得金额，现金付款进度、设备订单和投产时间仍待验证。

next.en: Reconcile asset acquisitions with the next cash-flow statement and project disclosures.
next.zh: 核对下一期现金流量表和项目披露，确认取得资产与现金开支的对应关系。

title.en: Alphabet closes €6 billion senior notes offering
title.zh: Alphabet 完成 60 亿欧元优先票据发行

change.en: Alphabet closed €6 billion of senior notes on November 5 and a separate C$6 billion offering on November 24. Both were debt financings. In Q3, Alphabet sold 12 million Class A and 24 million Class C shares under its ATM program for net proceeds of $4.3 billion and $8.1 billion, respectively. Approximately $27.6 billion remained available at September 30. Quarterly free cash flow was negative $9.065 billion and trailing twelve-month free cash flow was positive $19.747 billion.
change.zh: Alphabet 于 11 月 5 日完成 60 亿欧元优先票据发行，11 月 24 日另完成 60 亿加元优先票据发行。两笔均为债务融资。三季度通过 ATM 计划发行 1,200 万股 A 类股和 2,400 万股 C 类股，分别筹得净额 43 亿及 81 亿美元，计划于 9 月末剩余约 276 亿美元。季度自由现金流为负 90.65 亿美元，过去十二个月为正 197.47 亿美元。

meaning.en: The executed Q3 ATM equity sales met the financing clause. Trailing free cash flow remained positive. The two senior-note offerings are separate debt events.
meaning.zh: 三季度已执行的 ATM 股权发行触发融资分句。过去十二个月自由现金流仍为正，两笔优先票据属于分开记录的债务融资。

next.en: Check trailing free cash flow, ATM sales and remaining authorization in the next cash-flow statement and financing note.
next.zh: 在下一期现金流量表和融资附注核对 TTM 自由现金流、ATM 发行及剩余额度。

title.en: Alphabet reiterates 2027 timing for most TPU agreement revenue as consolidated inventory rises
title.zh: Alphabet 重申 TPU 系统协议收入绝大部分在 2027 年确认，合并存货继续上升

change.en: Alphabet's Q3 Form 10-Q says it began recognizing revenue in Q2 from a limited number of TPU system supply agreements, with the significant majority expected in 2027. Consolidated inventory rose from $9.991 billion at June 30 to $13.308 billion at September 30, up $3.317 billion or about 33.2% sequentially. Alphabet says inventory primarily includes TPU system hardware and consumer devices, and Cloud product revenue comes primarily from TPU system sales.
change.zh: Alphabet 三季度 10-Q 称，面向特定客户的少数 TPU 系统供应协议自二季度开始确认收入，绝大部分预计于 2027 年确认。合并存货由 6 月末 99.91 亿美元升至 9 月末 133.08 亿美元，环比增加 33.17 亿美元，约 33.2%。公司称存货主要包括 TPU 系统硬件和消费设备，Cloud 产品收入主要来自 TPU 系统销售。

meaning.en: The filing still puts most agreement revenue in 2027. Consolidated inventory includes consumer devices, and the two Forms 10-Q provide no separate Cloud product revenue or TPU sales line to test whether sales kept pace with inventory. The composite reading remains unclear.
meaning.zh: 申报仍指向 2027 年确认绝大部分协议收入。合并存货包含消费设备，且两份 10-Q 均未单列 Cloud 产品收入或 TPU 销售金额，无法判断销售是否追上存货增长。综合读数仍不明确。

next.en: Check the FY2026 Form 10-K and 2027 quarterly filings for TPU agreement revenue, Cloud product revenue and an inventory breakdown.
next.zh: 关注 FY2026 10-K 和 2027 年季报对 TPU 协议收入、Cloud 产品收入和存货拆分的披露。

title.en: Amkor's Arizona construction costs rose $219.7 million from June to September
title.zh: Amkor 亚利桑那项目在建成本较六月末增加 2.197 亿美元

change.en: Amkor's Q3 Form 10-Q reports $553.3 million of cumulative construction costs for the Arizona Facility at September 30, including $8.5 million of capitalized interest. The June 30 filing showed $333.6 million, a $219.7 million increase by subtraction. The Q3 filing still expects the transaction for approximately 67 additional acres to close in Q4 2026.
change.zh: Amkor 三季度 10-Q 披露，截至 9 月末亚利桑那项目累计发生建设成本 5.533 亿美元，含资本化利息 850 万美元。6 月末为 3.336 亿美元，按两期披露相减增加 2.197 亿美元。三季度申报仍预计 67 英亩追加土地交易于 2026 年四季度交割。

meaning.en: Construction costs and an expected land closing do not establish Phase 1 completion or production. The FY2025 Form 10-K put production in H1 2028. The Q3 filing does not restate Phase 1 timing or quantify named multiyear volumes. Q3 company-wide gross margin was 18.3% in a period before the original startup window. The three trigger legs remain unresolved.
meaning.zh: 建设成本和预计土地交割均不证明一期完工或投产。FY2025 10-K 的投产基线为 2028 年上半年；三季度 10-Q 未重列一期时点或点名多年期合约量。三季度公司整体毛利率为 18.3%，该时期早于项目原计划投产期。三条触发腿仍无法全面判定。

next.en: Look for Phase 1 completion and production milestones, named contracted volumes, and comparable gross margins after startup.
next.zh: 等待一期完工和投产里程碑、点名客户的合约量，以及投产后可比较的毛利率披露。

title.en: Almonty repurchased and cancelled 2.91 million shares in Q3
title.zh: Almonty 第三季度实际回购并注销 291 万股

change.en: Almonty’s November 12 Q3 MD&A and financial statements report the repurchase and cancellation of 2,914,739 shares at a weighted average US$16.58 and another 703,053 after quarter-end. Reported shares outstanding fell from 288,109,013 at June 30 to 285,670,318 at September 30, a net sequential decrease of 2,438,695 shares (0.85%).
change.zh: Almonty 11 月 12 日的三季度 MD&A 和报表披露，当季按加权均价 16.58 美元回购并注销 2,914,739 股，季后又回购并注销 703,053 股。公司披露的在外股数由 6 月末 288,109,013 股降至 9 月末 285,670,318 股，环比净减 2,438,695 股（0.85%）。

meaning.en: The Q3 share count fell, and disclosed financing and equity activity support a within reading for the quarter. The nine-month share movement includes 15,047,619 shares issued in January on conversion of an older debenture and 10,761,210 shares issued on exercises of options, CDI options and warrants and on RSU settlement, against 2,914,739 shares repurchased. A further 266,666 shares were issued after quarter-end to settle restricted stock units.
meaning.zh: 三季度股数下降，披露的当季融资与股本变化支持本期维持阈内。九个月股本变动包括 1 月旧债转换发行的 15,047,619 股、行使期权/CDI 期权/认股权证及结算限制性股票单位发行的 10,761,210 股，另有回购注销 2,914,739 股，季后另有结算限制性股票单位发行的 266,666 股。

next.en: Check new funding, actual convertible settlement and executed repurchases in the next filing.
next.zh: 下一期核对新增融资、可转债实际结算及已执行回购。

title.en: Alphabet discloses behavioral remedies in the US ad-tech case
title.zh: Alphabet 披露美国广告技术案的行为性救济决定

change.en: In its Q3 Form 10-Q filed October 29, Alphabet said the Eastern District of Virginia denied the DOJ’s request for structural divestitures of advertising technology assets in September 2026 and ordered remedies concerning interoperability, data access and auction conduct. Alphabet said that after the court enters final judgment it plans to appeal the adverse portion of the April 2025 decision and may also appeal aspects of the September 2026 remedies decision, and that the Search appeals were still pending.
change.zh: Alphabet 在 10 月 29 日申报的三季度 10-Q 中披露，弗吉尼亚东区法院于 2026 年 9 月驳回 DOJ 要求剥离广告技术资产的请求，并作出涉及互操作、数据访问和竞价行为的救济决定。Alphabet 称，法院登记终局判决后，将就 2025 年 4 月判决中的不利部分提起上诉，并可能对 2026 年 9 月救济决定的部分内容提起上诉；Search 案双方上诉仍待决。

meaning.en: Both legs support a within reading as of that filing. The ad-tech disclosure describes the remedies decision, while the Search disclosure describes the status of the appeals.
meaning.zh: 以这份申报为限，本次读数为阈内。广告技术案披露的是救济决定，Search 案披露的是上诉状态。

next.en: Check the Eastern District of Virginia’s final judgment and any resulting appeal, as well as the D.C. Circuit’s disposition of the Search remedies.
next.zh: 核对弗吉尼亚东区终局判决及相关上诉结果，并跟踪哥伦比亚特区巡回法院对 Search 救济范围的裁定。

title.en: Alphabet’s Q3 depreciation rose and both margins stayed above monitoring thresholds
title.zh: Alphabet Q3 折旧上升，合并与 Cloud 利润率仍高于监测阈值

change.en: Alphabet’s October 28 Q3 release reports depreciation of property and equipment of US$8.369 billion, up from US$5.611 billion a year earlier. Consolidated operating income of US$40.576 billion on revenue of US$127.577 billion gives a 31.8% margin. Google Cloud operating income of US$11.121 billion on segment revenue of US$30.709 billion gives a 36.2% margin.
change.zh: Alphabet 10 月 28 日公布的三季度业绩显示，物业与设备折旧为 83.69 亿美元，上年同期为 56.11 亿美元。合并经营利润 405.76 亿美元除以收入 1,275.77 亿美元得 31.8%。Google Cloud 营业利润 111.21 亿美元除以分部收入 307.09 亿美元得 36.2%。

meaning.en: Both margins remained above their respective thresholds of about 30% and 25%, supporting a within reading for the quarter. The depreciation figure is consolidated and the Cloud margin is segment-level.
meaning.zh: 本季两个利润率均高于约 30% 和 25% 的对应阈值，监测读数维持阈内。折旧金额属于集团披露，Cloud 利润率是分部口径。

next.en: Recalculate both margins on the same basis next quarter and check the disclosed contribution of depreciation and data-center operating costs.
next.zh: 下一期用同口径重算两项营业利润率，并核对折旧与数据中心运营成本的归因。

title.en: Airbnb’s surety bond in the Spanish short-term rental fine case
title.zh: Airbnb 西班牙短租罚款案的保函

change.en: Note 9 of the Q3 10-Q says Airbnb entered into a May 2026 agreement to obtain a EUR 70 million surety bond covering a proposed Spanish fine of about EUR 65 million and related interest.
change.zh: Q3 10-Q 附注 9 披露，公司于 2026 年 5 月签订协议取得 7,000 万欧元保函，为西班牙约 6,500 万欧元的拟议罚款及相关利息提供担保。

meaning.en: The bond suspends enforcement pending resolution. Airbnb disputes the fine and the applicability of the rules and says a potential loss is neither probable nor estimable.
meaning.zh: 保函用于在案件解决前暂缓执行。Airbnb 仍对罚款及规则适用有争议，称潜在损失既非很可能发生，也无法估计。

next.en: Check later filings for a court decision, a change to the bond, or a major-market short-term rental ban or cap that Airbnb identifies as material.
next.zh: 核对后续申报是否披露法院裁决、保函变动，或公司认定为重大的主要市场短租禁令或上限。

title.en: Palantir US commercial RDV growth trails revenue for two quarters
title.zh: Palantir 美国商业 RDV 增速连续两季低于收入

change.en: Q2/Q3 US commercial RDV grew 124%/79% YoY against 149%/148% revenue growth. Q3 stock-based compensation was 13.78% of revenue, versus 13.70% in Q2 and 14.59% a year earlier.
change.zh: Q2／Q3 美国商业 RDV 同比增长 124%／79%，收入增长 149%／148%。Q3 股权激励占收入 13.78%，Q2 为 13.70%，上年同期为 14.59%。

meaning.en: RDV meets the existing two-quarter monitor. TCV lagged revenue only in Q3.
meaning.zh: RDV 达到原连续两季监测门槛。TCV 只落后一季，不能据此判为两个季度的 TCV 增速逆转。

next.en: Compare like-for-like RDV, TCV and revenue growth next quarter and check whether stock-based compensation intensity falls.
next.zh: 复核下一季同口径 RDV、TCV 与收入增速，并检验股权激励占比能否回落。

title.en: Nebius filing confirms Avride received $75M of SAFE funding
title.zh: Nebius 申报确认 Avride 收到 $75M SAFE 资金

change.en: Note 6 of Exhibit 99.2 to the November 12 Form 6-K says Avride issued an additional SAFE to SMB Holding after meeting specified milestones in June 2026 and received $75.0M in cash. The instrument is classified as a liability. Note 5 records zero quarterly upward adjustment for ClickHouse and attributes the $780.6M nine-month adjustment to remeasurement following the January financing.
change.zh: 11 月 12 日 6-K 附件 99.2 附注 6 显示，Avride 于 2026 年 6 月在达到约定里程碑后向 SMB Holding 发行额外 SAFE 并收到 $75.0M，账上列为负债。附注 5 显示 ClickHouse 投资本季账面上调为零，前九个月的 $780.6M 上调来自 1 月融资的重估。

meaning.en: The SAFE confirms outside funding paid to Avride. The ClickHouse movement was a non-cash remeasurement. A stake sale, cash proceeds to the parent or an equity conversion of this SAFE still requires evidence, so the reading is unclear.
meaning.zh: SAFE 确认 Avride 获得外部融资，现金收款方为 Avride。ClickHouse 的变动是非现金重估。股权出售、向母公司回款或本次 SAFE 转成股权仍待证据，读数为 unclear。

next.en: Check for a SAFE conversion, a named equity partnership or a stake disposal, distinguishing proceeds to a subsidiary from monetization by the parent.
next.zh: 核对后续 SAFE 转股、具名股权合作或股权处置公告，并区分子公司融资与母公司变现。

title.en: Nebius discloses its July term-loan balance and covenant compliance
title.zh: Nebius 披露 7 月定期贷款余额及履约情况

change.en: In Exhibit 99.2 to the November 12 Form 6-K, Nebius disclosed a $773.3M secured July term loan, with $751.8M of principal outstanding at September 30 and covenant compliance, including a minimum debt-service coverage ratio of 1.15:1. The separate $3.5B Citi bridge agreed in October appears as a subsequent event.
change.zh: 11 月 12 日 6-K 附件 99.2 显示，7 月签订的有担保定期贷款金额为 $773.3M，截至 9 月 30 日本金余额 $751.8M，借款人符合包括 1.15:1 最低偿债覆盖率在内的财务契约。10 月签订的 $3.5B Citi 过桥额度在期后事项中单列。

meaning.en: The shareholder letter’s more-than-100% prepayment coverage applies to capex associated with Q3 agreements. Its 75%–85% figure is expected financing coverage for 2027 capex. The original claim that more than 90% of 2026 capex was secured still lacks a comparable update, leaving the reading unclear.
meaning.zh: 股东信所称预付款覆盖超过 100% 指第三季度新签协议对应的资本开支。其 75%–85% 指 2027 年资本开支的预期资金覆盖率。原先「2026 年资本开支超过 90% 已锁定」的说法仍缺可比数据，读数维持 unclear。

next.en: Look for comparable full-year 2026 capex coverage, actual Citi drawdowns and covenant compliance, and repayment or long-term take-out financing for any drawn balance.
next.zh: 核对全年 2026 年资本开支的可比已锁定比例、Citi 实际提款与契约履约，以及已提款部分的偿还或长期置换安排。

title.en: NVIDIA discloses $118.0B maximum gross guarantee exposure
title.zh: NVIDIA 披露担保最高总敞口升至 $118.0B

change.en: Exhibit 99.2 to the November 17 Form 8-K reports $118.0B maximum gross guarantee exposure as of October 25. This comprises $105.0B for SB Energy, $3.5B for neocloud land, power and shell guarantees, and $9.5B for power and systems credit support. The disclosed ceiling rose $9.5B from the Q2 Form 10-Q figure of $108.5B. NVIDIA reported no guarantee payments to date.
change.zh: 11 月 17 日 8-K 附件 99.2 显示，截至 10 月 25 日，担保最高总敞口为 $118.0B。SB Energy 为 $105.0B，neocloud 土地、电力和厂房担保为 $3.5B，电力与系统信用支持为 $9.5B。相对 Q2 10-Q 的 $108.5B，披露上限增加 $9.5B。发行人称截至披露时未就担保付款。

meaning.en: The disclosure distinguishes the guarantee ceiling from payments. NVIDIA also recorded $1.8B of non-marketable equity impairment. The exhibit does not name the impaired investees or provide enough detail to verify independent demand and repayment capacity for the new credit support. The trigger reading remains unclear.
meaning.zh: 披露区分了担保上限与实际付款。同期非上市股权证券减值 $1.8B，附件未列明对应被投对象，也未提供足以核验新信用支持独立需求及偿付能力的条款。原触发条件读数维持 unclear。

next.en: Check the Q3 Form 10-Q or later exhibits for terms of new credit support, the impaired investees, actual guarantee payments and evidence of counterparties’ repayment capacity.
next.zh: 核对 Q3 10-Q 或后续附件的新增信用支持条款、减值标的、实际付款及交易对手偿付依据。

title.en: MP Materials Q3 10-Q: capex guidance holds and first-half PPA cash was collected
title.zh: MP Materials Q3 10-Q：资本开支指引持平，上半年 PPA 款项已收

change.en: The subsequently filed Q3 10-Q confirms $500M–$600M of annual net capex guidance, $1,337.911M of quarter-end liquidity and approximately $110.9M of PPA cash receipts by September 30 for Q4 2025 and H1 2026.
change.zh: 随后提交的 Q3 10-Q 确认年度净资本开支仍指引 $500M–$600M，期末流动性 $1,337.911M，并披露截至 9 月末已收到对应 2025 Q4 与 2026 上半年 PPA 收入的约 $110.9M。

meaning.en: Liquidity exceeds the monitoring threshold and the filing directly supports collection of prior-period PPA accruals. Segment earnings excluding PPA are positive and include a one-time sale whose profit was not disclosed separately.
meaning.zh: 期末流动性高于监测门槛，PPA 前期已确认款项有直接收款依据。剔除 PPA 后分部利润为正，其中仍含未单列利润的一次性交付。

next.en: Use the subsequent filings to check collection of the Q3 PPA accrual and the next period’s capex, liquidity and segment profitability.
next.zh: 在后续申报核对 Q3 新增 PPA 应收的到账及下一期资本开支、流动性和分部利润。

title.en: Nebius turns an operating profit in Q3 while the nine-month result still depends on the ClickHouse mark
title.zh: Nebius Q3 经营转正，前九个月累计利润仍受 ClickHouse 重估支撑

change.en: The accompanying 6-K financial statements report a $253.5M nine-month operating loss and $393.3M of continuing-operations net income, including a $780.6M ClickHouse remeasurement gain.
change.zh: 同期 6-K 财务报表披露，前九个月累计经营亏损 $253.5M，持续经营净利润 $393.3M，其中包含 $780.6M 的 ClickHouse 投资重估收益。

meaning.en: The quarterly operating improvement coexists with a year-to-date operating loss. Year-to-date net income does not establish sustained operating profitability.
meaning.zh: 单季经营改善与累计经营亏损同时成立。累计净利润不能作为经营已持续转正的证据。

next.en: Check the next quarterly and full-year operating results and isolate any investment remeasurement.
next.zh: 用下一份业绩披露核对单季度和全年经营利润，单列任何投资重估影响。

title.en: Lumentum Q1 FY2027 customer concentration and quarterly diluted shares
title.zh: Lumentum Q1 FY2027 客户集中度与季度摊薄股数

change.en: For the quarter ended September 26, 2026, the two largest end customers accounted for 37% and 11% of net revenue (22% and 21% a year earlier). Form 10-Q Note 3 used 101.7M weighted-average diluted shares for GAAP EPS. The earnings release used 101.0M for non-GAAP EPS.
change.zh: 截至 2026-09-26 的季度，最大两家终端客户占净收入 37% 和 11%（上年同期 22% 和 21%）。10-Q 附注 3 的 GAAP 每股收益采用 101.7M 加权摊薄股，业绩稿的非 GAAP 口径为 101.0M。

meaning.en: The 37% share crosses the 35% customer threshold. The two share counts are period-weighted EPS denominators. The working fully diluted share count and cash-retention condition still require separate evidence.
meaning.zh: 37% 已超过单一客户 35% 门槛。两项股数是季度每股收益的加权分母，尚不足以核定研究所用的完全稀释分母与现金留存条件。

next.en: Use a same-date capitalization and cash-retention bridge to test the 104M condition and adjudicate how the concentration leg relates to the original compound trigger.
next.zh: 用同一截点的资本结构和现金留存桥核对 104M 条件，明确集中度腿与原复合条件的关系。

title.en: Western Digital Q1 FY2027 10-Q confirms pre-redemption shares and repurchases
title.zh: 西部数据 Q1 FY2027 10-Q 核实赎回前在外股数及回购

change.en: The 10-Q cover reports 374,323,269 shares outstanding at the October 15, 2026 close, up 13,782,325 from the August 7 10-K cover. The company repurchased 2.0M shares under its program for about $1.00B in cash during the quarter. The three subperiod purchase averages were $526.29, $488.15 and $461.59, all above the report’s historical $448.17 anchor.
change.zh: 10-Q 封面列示 2026-10-15 收盘在外 374,323,269 股，较 10-K 封面的 2026-08-07 多 13,782,325 股。季度内按计划回购 200 万股，现金成本约 10 亿美元。三段购股均价分别为 526.29、488.15、461.59 美元，均高于报告历史锚 448.17 美元。

meaning.en: Shares outstanding rose across the cover dates despite repurchases. The $141M of principal outstanding at October 2 and the $109,505,000 called in the September 14 announcement need reconciliation by date and settlement scope. The October cover count predates the November 16 redemption date.
meaning.zh: 在外股数在回购期间仍上升。10-Q 列示截至 10 月 2 日未偿本金 1.41 亿美元与 9 月 14 日新闻稿所列拟赎回的 109,505,000 美元需按日期及结算范围对账。10 月封面股数早于 11 月 16 日赎回日。

next.en: Review both original legs against issuer-reported redemption and conversion settlement, a post-redemption outstanding-share count and same-date capitalization.
next.zh: 以发行人披露的赎回和转股实绩、赎回后在外股数及同截点资本结构，复核两条原条件。

title.en: Vertiv Q3 results exceeded the high end of guidance on all six metrics
title.zh: Vertiv 第三季度六项实绩超过指引上限

change.en: All six Q3 results exceeded the July guidance ceiling. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.38 above the ceiling and adjusted operating margin was 0.2 percentage points higher.
change.zh: 六项 Q3 实绩超过 7 月指引上限，调整后摊薄 EPS 高出 $0.38，调整后营业利润率高出 0.2 个百分点。

meaning.en: Q3 did not meet the guide-miss prerequisite.
meaning.zh: Q3 未出现指引落空这一监测前提。

next.en: Compare the next reported quarterly results with guidance for the same period.
next.zh: 用下一次公布的季度实绩核对同期间指引。

title.en: AXT discloses Tongmei industrial site acquisition agreement
title.zh: AXT 披露通美工业用地项目收购协议

change.en: Tongmei agreed to buy a company holding approximately 69,452 m² of industrial land-use rights in Beijing for RMB 115,132,900.
change.zh: 通美签约，拟以 115,132,900 元人民币收购一家持有北京约 69,452 平方米工业土地使用权的公司。

meaning.en: The agreement identifies a site for possible future expansion. The filing gives no completion date or output target.
meaning.zh: 协议明确了未来扩产的候选用地，申报未给出交割日期或产量目标。

next.en: Track the closing, commissioning timetable and actual 2027 output disclosures.
next.zh: 跟踪交割、投产时间表及 2027 年实际产量披露。

title.en: Vistra files Q3 balance sheet before the Cogentrix close
title.zh: Vistra 披露 Cogentrix 交割前的第三季资产负债表

change.en: Vistra’s Q3 10-Q shows comparable quarter-end debt-like obligations less cash down 5.2% to $19.025B. Nine-month operating cash flow less the stated capital spending rose to $2.011B from $722M.
change.zh: Vistra 第三季申报显示，按同一口径计算的季末债务类项目减现金环比下降 5.2% 至 190.25 亿美元。前九个月经营现金流减指定资本开支由 7.22 亿美元升至 20.11 亿美元。

meaning.en: The September balance sheet predates Cogentrix. Repayment of the assumed debt used cash and facility borrowing, so comparable post-close leverage remains open.
meaning.zh: 九月资产负债表早于 Cogentrix 交割。承担债务以现金及融资工具借款偿还，交割后同口径杠杆仍待核。

next.en: Check acquisition-date balances and supplemental pro forma results in the 2026 Form 10-K.
next.zh: 在 2026 年 10-K 中核对收购日余额与补充备考业绩。

title.en: Micron discloses $12.75B in strategic customer deposits
title.zh: 美光披露战略客户协议现金押金 127.5 亿美元

change.en: Micron’s FY2026 filing reports $12.75B of realized cash deposits under multiyear strategic customer agreements, with nearly all scheduled for repayment in 2029–2031.
change.zh: 美光 FY2026 年报披露多年期战略客户协议实收现金押金 127.5 亿美元，几乎全部预计在 2029–2031 年返还。

meaning.en: The filing identifies a financing cash inflow and describes take-or-pay pricing terms. The realized SCA revenue share and margin effect remain open.
meaning.zh: 年报确认了融资现金流入，并披露照付不议及定价条款。协议实际收入占比和对毛利率的影响仍待核实。

next.en: Check future filings for realized SCA revenue and margin data and any customer or regulatory pushback.
next.zh: 继续核查后续文件中的协议实际收入与毛利率，以及客户或监管方是否反弹。

title.en: Meta says U.S. teen mental health agreement includes product changes
title.zh: Meta 披露美国青少年心理健康协议包含产品改动

change.en: Meta’s Q3 10-Q says its August 2026 agreement with state attorneys general over teen mental health includes changes to Facebook and Instagram features for U.S. users under 18. Meta says an independent auditor will report to the states annually on compliance for five years.
change.zh: Meta 在 Q3 10-Q 披露，2026 年 8 月与美国各司法辖区总检察长达成的青少年心理健康协议包含面向美国未满 18 岁用户的 Facebook 和 Instagram 功能改动。Meta 称独立审计人将连续五年每年向各州报告合规情况。

meaning.en: The issuer’s filing identifies concrete youth-product obligations beyond a litigation reserve. The filing does not specify the full set of feature changes or confirm that they have been rolled out.
meaning.zh: 发行人申报披露了具体的青少年产品整改义务。完整功能清单、执行时间及落地情况仍需协议原文和后续披露。

next.en: Check the underlying agreement or regulator materials for the exact scope, effective dates and implementation.
next.zh: 取得协议或监管原文后，核对整改细项、生效日期和执行情况。

title.en: Micron’s FY2026 10-K gives first-wafer timelines for three U.S. fabs
title.zh: 美光 FY2026 10-K 披露美国三座晶圆厂的首批产出时间

change.en: Micron projects first DRAM wafer output at its first Idaho fab in mid-calendar 2027, initial wafer output at its second Idaho fab by late calendar 2028, and initial wafer output at its first New York fab in calendar 2030.
change.zh: 美光预计爱达荷州第一座厂于 2027 年年中产出首批 DRAM 晶圆，第二座厂于 2028 年底前产出首批晶圆，纽约州第一座厂于 2030 年产出首批晶圆。

meaning.en: These are projected first-wafer dates. Micron’s FY2026 filing describes AI memory and storage demand growing faster than industry supply. The projections cannot yet establish the rate of saleable bit output or the effect of U.S. and Korean expansion on pricing.
meaning.zh: 这些是首批晶圆的计划时间。美光在 FY2026 年报中称 AI 内存及存储需求增速高于行业供给。上述计划尚不足以判断可售 bit 供给增速或美韩扩产对价格的影响。

next.en: Compare actual saleable bit shipments and ramp milestones with AI demand growth and comparable contract prices.
next.zh: 后续将实际可售 bit 出货、爬坡里程碑与 AI 需求增速及可比合约价格对照。

title.en: Spotify Q3 monitoring correction and follow-up
title.zh: Spotify Q3 监控勘误与补充

change.en: Q3 Ad-Supported revenue grew 9% at constant currency. Premium added 6M net subscribers and LTM free cash flow was €3.190B.
change.zh: Q3 广告支持收入恒定汇率增长 9%，Premium 净增 600 万，过去十二个月自由现金流为 €3.190B。

meaning.en: Ad gross margin improved year over year, while constant-currency ad growth remained below double digits. Q4 operating-income guidance of €820M was €70M above the monitoring threshold.
meaning.zh: 广告毛利率同比改善，广告收入的恒定汇率增速仍低于双位数。Q4 营业利润指引 €820M，高于监控阈值 €70M。

next.en: Use Q4 segment disclosures to evaluate the H2 advertising condition and clarify the tolerance around the approximate €3.3B LTM free cash flow threshold.
next.zh: 结合 Q4 分部披露核对下半年广告条件，并明确过去十二个月自由现金流约 €3.3B 的阈值容差。

title.en: Reddit’s Q3 net share count rose despite buybacks
title.zh: Reddit Q3 执行回购，期末净股数仍上升

change.en: Reddit repurchased 669,959 shares in Q3. Quarter-end Class A plus Class B shares outstanding rose by 794,917 (+0.41%).
change.zh: Reddit Q3 回购 669,959 股，期末 A 类与 B 类流通股数合计净增 794,917 股（+0.41%）。

meaning.en: The Q3 increase meets the first leg of the two-quarter monitoring condition.
meaning.zh: Q3 净股数上升，满足两季监测条件的第一条。

next.en: Compare the Q4 quarter-end Class A plus Class B count with the Q3 count when the filing is available.
next.zh: 取得 Q4 期末同口径流通股数后，与 Q3 期末读数比较。

title.en: Kioxia’s Q2 actuals exceed implied guidance while full-year guidance stays absent
title.zh: 铠侠 Q2 实绩超过隐含指引，全年指引持续缺席

change.en: Q2 revenue and attributable profit exceeded the implied guide by ¥90.0B and ¥85.7B. Full-year guidance remained absent.
change.zh: Q2 营收和归母净利润较隐含指引分别高 900 亿和 857 亿日元，全年指引持续缺席。

meaning.en: The issuer continued to withhold full-year guidance even though Q2 exceeded the guide; evaluation of the original alternative trigger is referred to Mode B.
meaning.zh: 尽管 Q2 实绩超出隐含指引，发行人仍未提供全年指引；原监测条件的评估交由 Mode B。

next.en: Check the next filing for any change in full-year disclosure policy and review investment implications separately.
next.zh: 核查下一份财报是否改变全年指引披露政策，并另行复核投资含义。

title.en: Kioxia adopts a formal shareholder return policy
title.zh: 铠侠通过正式股东回报方针

change.en: Kioxia approved progressive dividends and flexible repurchases, following execution of nearly the full ¥800B original buyback ceiling.
change.zh: 铠侠正式批准渐进式分红和灵活回购；已有回购执行金额几乎达到 8,000 亿日元上限。

meaning.en: The board resolution answers the previously open dividend-policy question. It establishes a framework for future allocation.
meaning.zh: 董事会决议确认正式分红方针，明确未来资金分配框架。

next.en: Verify payment of the first interim shareholder dividend and watch for a separate additional buyback resolution.
next.zh: 核实首次中期股息支付，并跟踪是否另行授权新增回购。

title.en: KLA quarterly free cash flow covers cash dividends and repurchases
title.zh: KLA 本季自由现金流覆盖现金分红和回购

change.en: Cash dividends and buybacks totaled $1,240.9M against $1,336.2M of quarterly FCF. KLA declared the next regular dividend at $0.23 per share.
change.zh: 本季现金分红和回购合计 12.41 亿美元，自由现金流为 13.36 亿美元。KLA 宣告下次常规股息每股 0.23 美元。

meaning.en: Quarterly FCF covered capital returns with about $95.3M remaining. Process-control revenue also grew in the quarter.
meaning.zh: 本季自由现金流覆盖资本回报，余约 0.95 亿美元，过程控制业务营收同期增长。

next.en: Check the next filing for cash-flow coverage of distributions and whether process-control demand stays resilient.
next.zh: 用后续财报复核现金流对分红和回购的覆盖，并跟踪过程控制需求。

title.en: Jinpan Q3: data-center revenue rises, cash conversion remains under review
title.zh: 金盘科技三季报：数据中心收入增长，现金转化仍待验证

change.en: Jinpan’s Q3 data-center revenue reached RMB 1.133B, up 179.41% year over year. Nine-month operating cash flow was RMB 90.74M, or 16.68% of profit attributable to shareholders.
change.zh: 金盘第三季度数据中心营收 11.33 亿元，同比 +179.41%。前三季度经营现金流净额 9,074.36 万元，约为归母净利润的 16.68%。

meaning.en: Data-center sales are being recognized. The filing does not separately identify SST commercialization or provide the comparable receivables evidence needed to grade collections.
meaning.zh: 数据中心业务已确认收入。季报未单列 SST 商业化，也缺同基期应收证据，暂不能判定回款质量。

next.en: Check the next filing for SST order fulfillment, recognized sales and comparable receivables or collections.
next.zh: 查下一份发行人文件中的 SST 交付、确认收入及可比应收或回款。

title.en: Tempus discloses Personalis cash election and credit commitments
title.zh: Tempus 披露 Personalis 现金对价和信贷承诺

change.en: Tempus elected about $600M in cash and expects roughly $900M in stock for Personalis. The new agreement provides $385M in term loan commitments and $115M in revolving commitments.
change.zh: Tempus 选择以约 6 亿美元现金支付部分 Personalis 对价，另预计支付约 9 亿美元股票，并签订 3.85 亿美元定期贷款及 1.15 亿美元循环承诺。

meaning.en: The election fixes a proposed cash component and adds conditional financing capacity. Funded debt, the closing cash position and the final shares issued still need verification.
meaning.zh: 披露明确了拟用现金和有条件的信贷额度，实际借款、交割现金及发行股数仍待核实。

next.en: Check the stockholder approval and closing disclosures for actual cash, debt drawings and issued shares.
next.zh: 查股东批准和交割文件中的实付现金、提款额及实际发股数。

title.en: Alphabet closes C$6 billion senior notes offering
title.zh: Alphabet 完成 60 亿加元优先票据发行

change.en: Alphabet closed four tranches of senior notes totaling C$6 billion on November 24, with maturities in 2029, 2034, 2038 and 2066.
change.zh: Alphabet 于 11 月 24 日完成四档合计 60 亿加元的优先票据发行，到期年份为 2029、2034、2038 和 2066。

meaning.en: The transaction adds Canadian-dollar debt financing. The Q3 ATM equity issuance remains a separate funding observation.
meaning.zh: 这次融资增加了加元债务。Q3 的 ATM 股权发行仍按原披露单独跟踪。

next.en: Check how the next filing reflects the notes in debt balances, financing cash flow and interest expense.
next.zh: 在下一份财报中核对发行计入债务余额、融资现金流及利息成本的情况。

title.en: Alphabet draws on its at-the-market program in Q3
title.zh: Alphabet Q3 实际动用按市价发行计划

change.en: Alphabet disclosed on October 28 that its at-the-market program sold 12 million Class A and 24 million Class C shares in Q3, with net proceeds of $4.3 billion and $8.1 billion, respectively, or $12.4 billion combined. Approximately $27.6 billion remained available at September 30.
change.zh: Alphabet 10 月 28 日披露，第三季度通过按市价发行计划发行 1,200 万股 A 类股和 2,400 万股 C 类股，分别筹得净额 43 亿及 81 亿美元，合计 124 亿美元。9 月末计划剩余约 276 亿美元额度。

meaning.en: The executed equity issuance meets the ATM clause of the funding monitor. Reported Q3 free cash flow was negative $9.065 billion, while trailing twelve-month free cash flow remained positive at $19.747 billion.
meaning.zh: 这是已经发生的股权融资，满足原现金流及融资监控项中的 ATM 分句。公司披露第三季度自由现金流为负 90.65 亿美元，过去十二个月仍为正 197.47 亿美元。

next.en: Independently review the funding signal under the published condition and follow the next cash-flow and issuance disclosures.
next.zh: 按原条款独立复核融资信号，并跟进下一期现金流与新增发行。

title.en: Meta pauses Class C common stock issuance during recapitalization proceedings
title.zh: Meta 在重组诉讼审前及庭审期间暂停发行 C 类普通股

change.en: Meta’s November 23 Form 8-K says it agreed to suspend Class C common stock issuance, including issuance through a stock dividend, during the pretrial and trial proceedings in Delaware Chancery Court. Trial is scheduled to begin April 19, 2027.
change.zh: Meta 11 月 23 日提交的 8-K 载明，公司同意在特拉华州衡平法院相关诉讼的审前及庭审期间暂停发行 C 类普通股，包括以股票股息方式发行。庭审计划于 2027 年 4 月 19 日开始。

meaning.en: Zuckerberg waived the original stock-dividend deadline. Meta expects the stock dividend and commencement of Class C trading to precede launch of the previously announced at-the-market program. The scheduled trial start does not establish an issuance date.
meaning.zh: 扎克伯格豁免了股息原定派发期限。公司预计要先派发股息并启动 C 类股交易，之后才会启动此前宣布的按市价发行计划。庭审开始日期不等于发行日期。

next.en: Watch for the case outcome, the waiver’s expiration and any new filing on the dividend or offering.
next.zh: 关注案件结果、豁免到期及公司对股息和发行计划的新公告。

title.en: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director
title.zh: NVIDIA 恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO 及董事职务

change.en: The November 23 Form 8-K says NVIDIA’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, effective immediately on November 22. Colette M. Kress continues as EVP and CFO, and Harvey C. Jones remains board chair.
change.zh: 11 月 23 日提交的 8-K 载明，NVIDIA 董事会于 11 月 22 日恢复黄仁勋的总裁、CEO 及董事职务，即时生效。Colette M. Kress 继续任 EVP 兼 CFO，Harvey C. Jones 继续任董事会主席。

meaning.en: The press release says the independent board committee will continue its investigation. A separate independent National Security and Export Control Committee was formed, and a chief compliance officer search is beginning. The reinstatement changes the management facts while the investigation remains in progress.
meaning.zh: 公司新闻稿称独立董事委员会会继续调查。董事会另设由独立董事组成的国家安全与出口管制委员会，并开始物色首席合规官。复任更新了治理状态，调查仍在进行。

next.en: Watch for the independent committee’s findings and the appointment of a chief compliance officer.
next.zh: 跟进独立委员会调查结论以及首席合规官任命。

title.en: Ondas shares outstanding rise 60.52% year over year
title.zh: Ondas 同日口径在外股数同比增加 60.52%

change.en: The two Form 10-Q covers show 368,459,664 and 591,442,459 common shares outstanding on November 10, 2025 and November 10, 2026 respectively. The calculated 60.52% increase exceeds the monitor’s 25% threshold.
change.zh: 两份 10-Q 封面分别披露 2025 年和 2026 年 11 月 10 日在外普通股 368,459,664 股和 591,442,459 股。同比增加 60.52%，超过在外股数监控项的 25% 阈值。

meaning.en: The 2026 Form 10-Q lists 44,999,998 deferred DZYNE consideration shares for delivery on January 4, 2027. They are excluded from the comparison, which uses the actual cover-page share counts.
meaning.zh: 2026 年 10-Q 将 44,999,998 股 DZYNE 递延对价列为 2027 年 1 月 4 日待交付，该笔未计入上述在外股数。股数为封面实报口径。

next.en: Independently review the funding and share-count condition, then follow the deferred delivery and the next disclosed share count.
next.zh: 独立复核融资和股数条件，再跟进递延对价交付与最新总股数。

title.en: Ondas reaffirms revenue targets and plans to slow acquisitions
title.zh: Ondas 股东信重申营收目标并拟放缓收购

change.en: Ondas’s November 23 shareholder letter reaffirmed revenue targets of at least $550 million for FY2026 and an initial $1.1 billion for FY2027, excluding additional acquisitions. Management intends to substantially slow new acquisitions, raise approval thresholds and prioritize delivery, integration and working capital.
change.zh: Ondas 11 月 23 日股东信重申 FY2026 营收至少 5.50 亿美元和 FY2027 初步目标至少 11 亿美元，均不含新增收购。管理层称拟大幅放缓新增收购，提高资本投放门槛，优先投入交付、整合和营运资本。

meaning.en: The new disclosure is management’s intended capital-allocation priority. The revenue targets carry over from the prior release. The letter contains no Q4 actuals establishing operating leverage.
meaning.zh: 新增信息是管理层提出的资本配置重点。营收目标延续前次披露，股东信尚未提供证明 Q4 经营杠杆改善的实绩。

next.en: Test execution against actual Q4 delivery, cash flow and adjusted cash operating expenses as a share of revenue.
next.zh: 用 Q4 实际交付、现金流和调整后现金经营费用率检验执行。

title.en: PayPal appoints Claire Bramley as its next CFO
title.zh: PayPal 任命 Claire Bramley 为下一任财务长

change.en: PayPal’s November 20 Form 8-K says the board appointed Claire Bramley as EVP and CFO effective February 3, 2027. Jamie Miller will step down as EVP, chief financial and operating officer effective February 2.
change.zh: PayPal 11 月 20 日的 8-K 载明，董事会任命 Claire Bramley 为执行副总裁兼 CFO，2027 年 2 月 3 日生效。Jamie Miller 将于 2 月 2 日卸任执行副总裁、财务长兼营运长。

meaning.en: The release gives February 1 as Bramley’s start date. The 8-K says Miller’s departure did not result from a disagreement over reported financial statements or related financial results.
meaning.zh: 公告所说的 2 月 1 日是 Bramley 到岗日。8-K 称 Miller 离任并非因双方对报告财务报表或相关业绩有分歧。

next.en: Follow post-transition financial disclosures and the next annual outlook.
next.zh: 跟进交接后财务披露与最新年度指引。

title.en: Cerebras Q3 dilution proxy of about 315.6M shares was below the 330M threshold
title.zh: Cerebras Q3 稀释代理约 3.156 亿股，低于 3.30 亿股门槛

change.en: At 2026-09-30, the Q3 10-Q shows 243.290M shares issued and outstanding and 72.326M potential shares excluded from diluted EPS. The existing proxy sums to about 315.616M shares.
change.zh: 截至 2026-09-30，Q3 10-Q 列示已发行在外股约 2.43290 亿股，另有 7,232.6 万股潜在股份未纳入稀释每股收益。按原定义加总约为 3.15616 亿股。

meaning.en: The Q3 reading was below the original 330M threshold. The prospectus terms and actual earnings release date imply a final lock-up expiry of 2026-11-09. The calculation cannot establish how many shares were sold.
meaning.zh: Q3 读数低于原 3.30 亿股门槛。按招股书条款和实际业绩发布日期，最终锁定期对应 2026-11-09。该推算无法确认实际售股数量。

next.en: Reconcile issued and outstanding shares and anti-dilutive potential shares on the same basis when the next 10-Q or 10-K is filed.
next.zh: 下一份 10-Q 或 10-K 披露后，继续按同一口径核对已发行在外股及反稀释潜在股份。

title.en: PayPal Q3 online branded checkout grew 1% and Venmo grew 14%
title.zh: PayPal 第三季度线上品牌结账增长 1%，Venmo 增长 14%

change.en: Q3 online branded checkout TPV rose 1% and Venmo rose 14% to US$96.810B on an FX-neutral year-over-year basis. The full-year adjusted free cash flow guide is US$6.5B or more.
change.zh: Q3 线上品牌结账 TPV 汇率中性同比增 1%，Venmo 增 14% 至 968.10 亿美元。全年调整后自由现金流指引为 65 亿美元以上。

meaning.en: Online branded checkout sits at the reported-precision threshold and the unrounded growth rate remains unknown. Venmo held up better and full-year adjusted free cash flow guidance exceeded the US$6B threshold.
meaning.zh: 线上品牌结账位于已披露精度的观察线，未四舍五入增速仍待核实。Venmo 相对更强，全年调整后自由现金流指引高于 60 亿美元观察线。

next.en: Check next quarter’s online branded checkout growth, Venmo volume and realized adjusted free cash flow.
next.zh: 核对下一季线上品牌结账增速、Venmo 交易额与调整后自由现金流实际。

title.en: TSMC and ASE reported higher October revenue
title.zh: 台积电和日月光封测 10 月营收增长

change.en: TSMC’s October consolidated revenue rose 14.7% from September. ASE’s assembly, testing and materials revenue rose 7.9%.
change.zh: 台积电 10 月合并营收环比增长 14.7%，日月光封装、测试及材料营收环比增长 7.9%。

meaning.en: Both monthly series grew. The releases leave advanced packaging capacity and customer orders open.
meaning.zh: 代工与第三方封测两组月度营收同步增长。先进封装产能和客户订单仍需专门披露。

next.en: Check November revenue and Q4 disclosures for node mix and packaging capacity.
next.zh: 跟踪 11 月营收，并核对 Q4 制程结构及封装产能披露。

title.en: Google Cloud revenue doubled while Alphabet’s quarterly cash deficit widened
title.zh: Google Cloud 收入翻倍，Alphabet 季度自由现金流缺口扩大

change.en: In Q3, Google Cloud revenue was $30.709B (+103% YoY), operating income was $11.121B (36.2% margin), and quarter-end Cloud backlog was $560.8B. Search & other revenue was $63.350B (+12%). Quarterly free cash flow was −$9.065B, while trailing free cash flow remained positive at $19.747B.
change.zh: Q3 Google Cloud 收入 307.09 亿美元（同比 +103%），营业利润 111.21 亿美元（利润率 36.2%），季末 Cloud 积压收入 5,608 亿美元。搜索及其他收入 633.50 亿美元（+12%）。季度自由现金流为负 90.65 亿美元，TTM 自由现金流仍为正 197.47 亿美元。

meaning.en: Cloud volumes and profitability grew while heavier capital spending squeezed cash. Search revenue data does not isolate monetization per AI query.
meaning.zh: 云业务收入和盈利增长，资本开支加重现金压力。搜索收入未拆分 AI 查询的单次变现。

next.en: Check backlog conversion, Search monetization, and whether trailing free cash flow approaches zero.
next.zh: 跟踪积压收入转化、搜索变现和 TTM 自由现金流是否接近零。

title.en: AWS grew 39.3% as Amazon’s trailing free cash flow fell to −$42.4B
title.zh: AWS 收入增长 39.3%，Amazon 过去十二个月自由现金流降至负 424 亿美元

change.en: Q3 AWS net sales were $45.984B and operating income was $17.773B, implying a 38.7% margin. Trailing operating cash flow of $168.300B less $210.657B of net property and equipment purchases left free cash flow of −$42.357B, versus −$7.604B a quarter earlier.
change.zh: Q3 AWS 净销售额 459.84 亿美元，营业利润 177.73 亿美元，计算得营业利润率 38.7%。TTM 经营现金流 1,683.00 亿美元减去净购置物业设备支出 2,106.57 亿美元，自由现金流为负 423.57 亿美元，前一季度为负 76.04 亿美元。

meaning.en: AWS growth and margin remain above the report’s downside levels. The trailing cash shortfall crossed $25B in Q3. Persistence into 2027 remains untested.
meaning.zh: AWS 增长与利润率仍高于报告的下行阈值。Q3 的 TTM 现金缺口已超过 250 亿美元，能否延续至 2027 年仍待核验。

next.en: Check the next trailing cash flow and long-term debt together with AWS margin.
next.zh: 同步复核下一期 TTM 自由现金流、长期债务及 AWS 利润率。

title.en: Bloom Energy raised its annual revenue outlook as operating cash flow turned negative
title.zh: Bloom Energy 上调全年收入指引，季度经营现金流转负

change.en: Bloom reported Q3 revenue of $1.236B (+138.1% YoY), product revenue of $1.074B (+179.4%), non-GAAP gross margin of 34.5% and operating cash outflow of $27.1M, versus inflow of $226.4M in Q2. It raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $4.4–4.6B.
change.zh: Bloom Q3 收入 12.358 亿美元（同比 +138.1%），产品收入 10.736 亿美元（+179.4%），非 GAAP 毛利率 34.5%。经营现金流净流出 2,714.7 万美元，Q2 净流入 2.264 亿美元。公司上调 FY2026 收入指引至 44–46 亿美元。

meaning.en: Revenue and margins advanced while quarterly cash conversion weakened. The results do not quantify incremental data-center orders separately.
meaning.zh: 收入与毛利率改善，季度现金转化走弱。业绩稿未单列数据中心新增订单。

next.en: Check Q4 operating cash flow and named order conversion.
next.zh: 跟踪 Q4 经营现金流及具名订单转化。

title.en: Meta’s ad metrics grew as reported margin and free cash flow weakened
title.zh: Meta 广告指标增长，报告利润率与自由现金流走弱

change.en: Q3 revenue rose 26% to $64.60B, ad impressions rose 10% and average ad price rose 14%. Reported operating margin was 20%, versus 40% a year earlier. The quarter included a $9.9B legal charge. Free cash flow was −$2.12B and the 2026 capex range rose at the low end to $135–145B, including finance-lease principal.
change.zh: Q3 营收同比 +26% 至 646.0 亿美元，广告展示量 +10%，平均广告价格 +14%。报告营业利润率 20%，上年同期为 40%，本季计入 99 亿美元诉讼费用。自由现金流为负 21.2 亿美元。含融资租赁本金的 2026 年资本开支指引下限上调，区间为 1,350–1,450 亿美元。

meaning.en: The reported margin is below the 35% operating monitor, alongside a quantified legal charge. The 2026 capex guide’s upper end is still $145B. This release gives no quantified 2027 capex range.
meaning.zh: 报告营业利润率低于监控项的 35%，同季包含已量化的诉讼费用。2026 年资本开支指引上限仍为 1,450 亿美元。该业绩稿未给出 2027 年资本开支区间。

next.en: Check 2027 capex guidance and whether margin recovers after the legal charge.
next.zh: 核对 2027 年资本开支指引及诉讼费用后的利润率能否恢复。

title.en: Micron beat fiscal Q4 guidance with $54.23B revenue and 87.0% adjusted gross margin
title.zh: 美光 FY2026 Q4 收入 542.3 亿美元，调整后毛利率 87.0%，超过指引

change.en: Fiscal Q4 revenue was $54.229B versus guidance of $49–51B. GAAP gross margin was 86.8% and non-GAAP gross margin was 87.0%. Fiscal Q1 FY2027 guidance was $61.5B ± $1.5B in revenue and about 86.25% non-GAAP gross margin.
change.zh: FY2026 Q4 收入 542.29 亿美元，高于 490–510 亿美元指引。GAAP 与非 GAAP 毛利率分别为 86.8% 和 87.0%。FY2027 Q1 收入指引为 615 亿美元上下 15 亿美元，非 GAAP 毛利率约 86.25%。

meaning.en: Reported and guided gross margin remain above 80%. The release does not quantify the volume of the 2027 HBM order book or the revenue mix from strategic customer agreements.
meaning.zh: 实际与指引毛利率仍高于 80%。业绩稿未量化 2027 年 HBM 订单覆盖或长期战略客户协议收入占比。

next.en: Check the fiscal Q1 margin and open the original HBM and agreement disclosures when quantities are available.
next.zh: 核对 FY2027 Q1 毛利率，待披露数量后复核 HBM 及长期战略客户协议原文。

title.en: Sandisk’s eight-for-one split took effect
title.zh: Sandisk 一股拆八股生效

change.en: Sandisk’s certificate amendment took effect at 4:01 p.m. Eastern Time on November 19 and provided for an eight-for-one forward split. Nasdaq shows the November 20 regular-session close on the post-split share basis at $79.24.
change.zh: Sandisk 的章程修订于美东时间 11 月 19 日 16:01 生效，每股拆分为八股。Nasdaq 显示 11 月 20 日常规盘收盘为拆股后的每股 79.24 美元。

meaning.en: Historical per-share anchors in the report are pre-split. Comparable per-share readings require the eight-for-one conversion.
meaning.zh: 报告的历史每股基准采用拆股前口径，比对时需按一股拆八股统一单位。

next.en: Use one split basis for subsequent per-share comparisons.
next.zh: 后续每股比较使用统一拆股口径。

title.en: Spotify reached 788M listeners and 306M subscribers, while quarterly free cash flow fell
title.zh: Spotify 月活达 7.88 亿、付费用户 3.06 亿，季度自由现金流下滑

change.en: Q3 MAUs were 788M, Premium subscribers 306M and revenue €4.969B (+16% YoY). Spotify marked revenue in line at the rounded €5.0B guidance precision. Gross margin was 33.0%, operating income €672M and free cash flow €735M (−9% YoY). Ad-Supported revenue was €482M (+10%, or +14% currency-neutral). The Q4 operating-income guide was €820M.
change.zh: Q3 月活 7.88 亿、付费用户 3.06 亿，收入 49.69 亿欧元（同比 +16%）。按 50 亿欧元指引的披露精度，公司判为符合指引。毛利率 33.0%，营业利润 6.72 亿欧元，自由现金流 7.35 亿欧元（同比 −9%）。广告支持业务收入 4.82 亿欧元（+10%，固定汇率 +14%）。Q4 营业利润指引为 8.20 亿欧元。

meaning.en: Premium subscribers and profitability exceeded guidance. Exact reported revenue is €31M below €5.0B, while the issuer reports in-line at rounded precision. Quarterly free cash flow and ad segment margin were below Q2.
meaning.zh: 付费用户及盈利水平超过指引。精确收入较 50 亿欧元低 3,100 万欧元，公司按四舍五入口径判为合规。季度自由现金流和广告分部毛利率低于 Q2。

next.en: Compare the Q4 print with the €820M operating-income guide and check ad-margin durability.
next.zh: 用 Q4 实际营业利润核对 8.20 亿欧元指引，并复查广告毛利率能否维持。

title.en: AMD completes World Labs acquisition and issues 14,978,322 shares
title.zh: AMD 完成收购 World Labs 并发行 14,978,322 股

change.en: AMD’s November 16 Form 8-K/A (Item 3.02) discloses that the World Labs acquisition closed on November 13 and that AMD issued 14,978,322 common shares to former World Labs holders. The filing restates the approximately $8.2 billion in stock consideration agreed at signing, subject to adjustment, and confirms the shares issued at closing.
change.zh: AMD 于 11 月 16 日提交的 8-K/A（Item 3.02）披露，World Labs 收购已于 11 月 13 日交割，向原股东发行 14,978,322 股 AMD 普通股。申报重述签约时约 82 亿美元的股票对价，金额依协议可调整，股数已由交割披露确认。

meaning.en: The World Labs transaction moved from announced to closed. The amendment addresses World Labs and supplies no Taalas closing, ROCm migration, rack-level price-performance or shipment data.
meaning.zh: 收购由已宣布协议进入已交割状态。该修订针对 World Labs，未提供 Taalas 交割、ROCm 客户迁移、机架性价比或出货数据。

next.en: Use subsequent financial filings to distinguish closing shares, purchase accounting, and later product and customer disclosures.
next.zh: 在后续季报中区分交割股数、购买会计及整合后的产品和客户披露。

title.en: Coherent board authorizes up to $2.0 billion in repurchases
title.zh: Coherent 董事会授权最多 20 亿美元回购

change.en: In its November 19 Form 8-K (Item 7.01), Coherent disclosed that its board authorized up to $2.0 billion of common-stock repurchases on November 18, excluding related expenses. The program has no expiry and can be suspended or discontinued.
change.zh: Coherent 11 月 19 日提交的 8-K（Item 7.01）披露，董事会于 11 月 18 日授权公司回购最多 20 亿美元普通股，额度不含相关费用。计划无到期日，可暂停或终止。

meaning.en: The authorization sets a capital-allocation limit. The 8-K gives no repurchase execution amount, share count or funding source. The November 4 quarterly filing remains the basis for quarterly free cash flow.
meaning.zh: 授权明确了资本配置上限。该 8-K 未披露已执行的回购金额、股数或资金来源，季度自由现金流仍按 11 月 4 日季报口径。

next.en: Check the next results or filing for actual repurchases, funding and cash flow.
next.zh: 用下一次财报或申报核对实际回购、资金来源和现金流。

title.en: AAOI signs a $550M ATM agreement
title.zh: AAOI 签订 5.50 亿美元 ATM 协议

change.en: AAOI signed a new at-the-market agreement on November 17, 2026 to sell common stock from time to time through two sales agents for up to $550 million in aggregate gross proceeds.
change.zh: AAOI 于 2026-11-17 签订新的按市价发行协议，可通过两家销售代理不时发行普通股，发行总额上限为 5.50 亿美元。

meaning.en: The company has no obligation to sell. The filing gives no shares issued, actual proceeds or revenue per share under this agreement. The Q3 cash-flow and revenue-per-share reading still refers to the reported quarter.
meaning.zh: 公司没有出售义务，公告也未披露该协议下已发行股数、实际所得或收入／股。Q3 现金流与收入／股监控仍按该季已经披露的读数。

next.en: Check subsequent filings for shares issued and net proceeds, then recheck the compound trigger against Q4 cash flow and revenue per share.
next.zh: 核对后续文件中的实际发行股数及净所得，再用 Q4 现金流与收入／股复验合取条件。

title.en: Sandisk files $88.9B of NBM remaining performance obligations
title.zh: SanDisk 季报披露 889 亿美元 NBM 剩余履约义务

change.en: Sandisk’s Q1 FY2027 10-Q, filed October 30, 2026, reports $88.9 billion of NBM remaining performance obligations at October 2. Of that total, $87.4 billion was unbilled and $1.5 billion recorded as contract liabilities. The company expects to recognize about 20% over the next 12 months.
change.zh: SanDisk 2026-10-30 提交的 Q1 FY2027 10-Q 披露，截至 10 月 2 日，NBM 剩余履约义务为 889 亿美元，其中 874 亿美元未开票，约 15 亿美元计入合同负债，约 20% 预计未来 12 个月确认为收入。

meaning.en: The company recognized $281 million of opening contract liabilities as revenue during the quarter. The footnote does not reconcile the aggregate RPO to the minimum revenue management attributed to five agreements. FY2027 bit coverage and deliveries against those five agreements remain unverified.
meaning.zh: 本季从期初合同负债确认收入 2.81 亿美元。该附注没有把 RPO 总额与管理层提及的五份协议最低收入逐项对账。FY2027 bit 覆盖和五份协议的逐单兑现仍待证实。

next.en: Track recognition, delivery by contract and explicit FY2027 bit coverage in subsequent filings.
next.zh: 追踪财报中的实际确认收入、逐协议交付与具名 FY2027 bit 覆盖。

title.en: Tempus and AstraZeneca renew their multiyear services commitment
title.zh: Tempus 与阿斯利康续签多年期服务承诺

change.en: Tempus and AstraZeneca signed the fifth amendment on November 16, 2026. The 2027–2031 renewal carries $200M of qualifying fee commitments, a $40M annual target and a $32M annual floor subject to the agreement’s terms.
change.zh: Tempus 与阿斯利康于 2026-11-16 签订第五次修订，续约期自 2027 年起至 2031 年底。合格费用承诺合计 2 亿美元，年度目标 4,000 万美元，合同约定年度最低支出 3,200 万美元并受具体条款约束。

meaning.en: The agreement provides a multiyear demand commitment. Terms govern the annual floor, and financial statements will establish revenue and product-mix effects.
meaning.zh: 协议给出多年期需求承诺。年度支出下限受合同条款约束，分部收入及产品组合影响还有待财报确认。

next.en: Track recognized revenue, spend against the commitment and Data and Applications mix from 2027.
next.zh: 跟踪自 2027 年起的收入确认、支出履约以及数据与应用分部的组合。

title.en: Cameco’s October long-term uranium indicator rose to US$98/lb
title.zh: Cameco 转引的 10 月长期铀价升至 98 美元/磅

change.en: Cameco’s month-end UxC and TradeTech averages on October 30, 2026 were US$98.00/lb long-term and US$91.55/lb spot, both above the September 30 values of US$96.50 and US$89.63/lb. The derived long-term premium narrowed from US$6.87 to US$6.45/lb.
change.zh: Cameco 转引 UxC 与 TradeTech 的月末均价。2026-10-30 长期价与现货分别为 98.00 与 91.55 美元/磅，较 2026-09-30 的 96.50 与 89.63 美元均上升。长期价减现货的价差从 6.87 收窄至 6.45 美元/磅（自算）。

meaning.en: The long-term indicator rose and remains above spot. Both Q2 and Q3 quarter-end long-term readings exceeded about US$90/lb, keeping the original condition within range.
meaning.zh: 长期价上涨且仍高于现货。Q2 和 Q3 季末长期价均高于约 90 美元/磅，原条件维持阈内。

next.en: Check the next published month-end spot and long-term indicators.
next.zh: 后续继续核对发行人转引的月末现货及长期指标。

title.en: Cerebras Q3 free cash flow was negative US$838.6 million
title.zh: Cerebras Q3 单季自由现金流为负 8.386 亿美元

change.en: Subtracting the cumulative cash-flow statements gives Q3 operating cash outflow of US$341.4M and cash purchases of property and equipment of US$497.2M, implying free cash flow of negative US$838.6M. Q2 free cash flow was negative US$476.7M on the same basis.
change.zh: 按 10-Q 累计数相减，Q3 单季经营现金净流出 3.414 亿美元，现金购建固定资产 4.972 亿美元，合计自由现金流为负 8.386 亿美元。Q2 同口径为负 4.767 亿美元。

meaning.en: Cash burn accelerated sequentially. Both quarters were above negative US$1.0B, so the consecutive-quarter threshold was not met. The attributable RPO from newly signed contracts is not needed to determine this cash-flow leg.
meaning.zh: 现金消耗环比加快，但两季均未跌破负 10 亿美元，连续两季的门槛未触发。新增合同 RPO 金额无需用于判定本轮现金流门槛。

next.en: Use the next 10-Q or 10-K to reconcile quarterly operating cash flow and cash capital expenditure on the same basis.
next.zh: 下一份 10-Q 或 10-K 继续用同口径核对单季经营现金流和现金资本开支。

title.en: Kioxia discloses its interim dividend in the semiannual filing

title.en: Almonty MD&A: November APT quote below September-end; neither continued-rise nor a valuation reset is established

change.en: The November 12, 2026 Q3 MD&A cites European APT market quotations of US$2,800/MTU at September-end and approximately US$2,650/MTU on November 6, a derived end-point decline of about 5.4%. It also describes a year-to-date rise from US$862.5 in early January; that does not imply no decline since September. The release's Q3 average of US$2,800 is not compared with a single-day November quote. This supersedes the current meaning of the old "quotation rose, therefore within" assessment: the end-point decline is evidenced, but whether it undermines the historical valuation premise lacks a current project-economics/valuation bridge, so unclear against the complete original condition. These are third-party MB market readings quoted by the issuer, not Almonty's realized price. No valuation or stance is changed, and the separate US$400 downgrade threshold is not claimed met.

change.en: The issuer's November 12, 2026 Q3 release discloses first Sangdong tungsten concentrate in September 2026 and loading of the first container at Busan after quarter-end for shipment to an overseas customer. The inspected project sections provide no comparable quarterly ramp plan, absolute output or unit cash cost, so sangdong-ramp remains unclear.
change.zh: 2026-11-12 发行人三季度业绩稿披露，Sangdong 于 2026 年 9 月产出首批钨精矿；季后首个精矿集装箱在釜山港装载、拟运往海外客户。装载不等于已交付、已确认收入或已回款。同日 MD&A 的项目章节仍称选矿厂在 2026 年四季度处于试车与爬坡，二期在一期运行及市场条件允许下可能于 2027 年完成。对照“矿山未按计划放量”原触发条件，首批产出和装载尚不能证明按计划达产，所核项目段没有可比季度爬坡计划、绝对产量或单位现金成本，sangdong-ramp 维持 unclear。

title.en: AMAT Q4 FY2026: systems growth and source-verified revenue, EPS and margin delivery
title.zh: AMAT FY2026 Q4：系统业务增长，实际收入、EPS 与利润率完成原指引比较

change.en: The November 12, 2026 release reports Q4 FY2026 (ended October 25) Semiconductor Systems revenue of $7,996M versus $4,879M a year earlier, +63.9% (derived); GAAP operating margin was 38.8% versus 29.3%, and non-GAAP 39.0% versus 29.6%. Both systems-revenue and operating-margin legs support within. Management attributes incremental demand to AI; one issuer segment does not independently prove the whole WFE cycle or HBM orders. Q4 FY2026 systems mix was foundry/logic 58%, DRAM 33% and flash 9%, versus 66%/28%/6% a year earlier. Multiplying rounded shares by segment revenue gives estimated foundry/logic revenue of about $4,637.7M and DRAM $2,638.7M, versus about $3,220.1M/$1,366.1M a year earlier; both grew YoY. These are derived estimates, not separately reported revenue, and are not split into HBM. Different quarters' foundry/logic/other labels do not establish identical scope. Both categories grew YoY, but HBM-specific revenue is undisclosed and category scope across quarters is unreconciled. YoY growth alone does not establish the full stays-strong/HBM condition, so reading=unclear; no customer orders or all sequential directions are inferred. Q4 FY2026 China revenue was $2,642M (25%; prior year $1,964M/29%) and Taiwan $2,916M (28%; $1,834M/27%), about +34.5%/+59.0% YoY (derived). The prior quarter's China YoY-decline observation does not describe this new period. The geography table does not attribute these changes to export controls or customer timing; that causal trigger leg remains unobserved, so unclear. Growth is not proof that restrictions were lifted. Q4 FY2026 actual revenue of $10,409M exceeded the published trigger's $10,250M midpoint by $159M (+1.6%, derived). Non-GAAP EPS was $4.16; GAAP/non-GAAP gross margins were 50.4%/50.6% and operating margins 35.1%/35.3%. The original August 13, 2026 Q3 release supplies Q4 guidance of: $10,250M revenue and $4.02 non-GAAP EPS at the midpoints. Q4 revenue exceeded the midpoint by 1.6%, and $4.16 non-GAAP EPS exceeded $4.02 by about 3.5%; GAAP/non-GAAP gross margins increased from Q3's 50.3%/50.4% to 50.4%/50.6%, and operating margins from 33.7%/34.0% to 35.1%/35.3%. On comparable quarterly actuals and original guidance, revenue, EPS and margins did not slip, so q3-guidance-conversion is within. This is not a change to valuation or full-year earnings estimates. Next-quarter revenue of $11,100M +/- $500M and non-GAAP EPS of $4.35 +/- $0.20 are guidance, not achieved results, and do not replace historical valuation denominators. At October 25, 2026 inventories were $6,889M versus $5,915M at the prior fiscal year-end (+16.5%) and receivables $8,998M versus $5,185M (+73.5%, derived). These are end-point balance comparisons, not the same measurement period as quarterly YoY revenue. The release gives no order or backlog amount; recognized revenue and inventory changes do not establish the original order-conversion or logistics-capacity requirement, so unclear. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026073360/exhibit991q42026earningsre.htm Original Q3 guidance source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026056699/exhibit991q32026earningsre.htm
change.zh: 2026-11-12 业绩稿：FY2026 Q4（截至 2026-10-25）Semiconductor Systems 收入 $7,996M，对上年同期 $4,879M 增长 63.9%（自算）；GAAP 营业利润率 38.8%（上年 29.3%）、non-GAAP 39.0%（29.6%）。按系统收入与营业利润率两腿评 within；公司称 AI 推动增量需求，但单一公司的分部数据不独立证明整个 WFE 周期或 HBM 订单。 FY2026 Q4 系统收入结构为 foundry/logic 58%、DRAM 33%、Flash 9%（上年 66%/28%/6%）。按已四舍五入占比乘分部收入估算，foundry/logic 约 $4,637.7M、DRAM 约 $2,638.7M，上年约 $3,220.1M/$1,366.1M，均同比增长。该估算不是公司单列收入，分类也未按 HBM 拆分；不同季度的 foundry/logic/other 标签不保证同口径。两类同比增长已获支持，但未披露 HBM 专项收入，且不同季度的分类范围未对账，不能仅据同比增长确认完整“保持强势/验证 HBM”条件，故 reading=unclear；不推断客户订单或全部环比方向。 FY2026 Q4 中国收入 $2,642M（占 25%，上年 $1,964M/29%）；台湾 $2,916M（28%，上年 $1,834M/27%），同比约 +34.5%/+59.0%（自算）。新期中国同比下降的旧现象已不适用；但表格没有把本期变化归因于出口管制或客户节奏，原触发条件的因果腿仍缺，故 unclear，不把收入增长解释成出口限制解除。 FY2026 Q4 实际收入 $10,409M，高于已发布触发器的 $10,250M 中点 $159M（+1.6%，自算）；non-GAAP EPS 为 $4.16，GAAP/non-GAAP 毛利率 50.4%/50.6%、营业利润率 35.1%/35.3%。已复核 2026-08-13 原 Q3 业绩稿所载 Q4 指引：收入中点 $10,250M、non-GAAP EPS 中点 $4.02。Q4 实际收入高于中点 1.6%，non-GAAP EPS $4.16 高于 $4.02 约 3.5%；GAAP/non-GAAP 毛利率由 Q3 的 50.3%/50.4% 升至 50.4%/50.6%，营业利润率由 33.7%/34.0% 升至 35.1%/35.3%。按同口径季度实际与原指引比较，收入、EPS 与利润率未失速，故 q3-guidance-conversion 评 within；这不是估值或全年盈利预测上调。下一季度 $11,100M±$500M 与 non-GAAP EPS $4.35±$0.20 是指引，不是已实现结果，不替换历史估值分母。 2026-10-25 存货 $6,889M，对上年财年末 $5,915M 为 +16.5%；应收账款 $8,998M 对 $5,185M 为 +73.5%（自算）；两者是期末对期末比较，不是与单季收入同比同一期间。业绩稿未给出订单或 backlog 金额；收入实现和存货变化不能证明原条目要求的订单转化或物流能力，故维持 unclear。 来源：https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026073360/exhibit991q42026earningsre.htm 原 Q3 指引来源：https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026056699/exhibit991q32026earningsre.htm

title.zh: AXT Q3 10-Q：合同负债与退款条件披露，不把可退款当实际退款

change.en: The Q3 10-Q filed November 12, 2026, Note 15, reports September 30 current contract liabilities of $82.512M plus non-current $25.707M = $108.219M (recomputed, matching the table; $0.103M at year-end 2025). change.zh: 2026-11-12 Q3 10-Q Note 15：2026-09-30 合同负债流动 $82.512M＋非流动 $25.707M＝$108.219M（自算，与表内合计一致；2025 年末 $0.103M）。所列长期协议 RPO 约 $293.5M，预计 2026 剩余期间确认 $15.5M、2027 年 $196.4M、以后 $81.6M，三项合计 $293.5M；合约预付款约 $179.5M，已收约 $92.4M。预付款与全部合同负债范围未对账，不强行相等或指认为某一客户。未用完预付款在协议规定条件下可退，不是已退款/终止证据；该节未给出 Coherent/Lumentum 分户履约及退款状态，原退款/终止腿仍未知，维持 unclear。

title.zh: Cerebras Q3：core 收入过原下限，RPO $26.1B；新客户金额及全年实绩仍待核

change.en: The November 12, 2026 release gives September 30 RPO of $26.1B, above the $24.0B floor. It names an Oracle relationship for planned service availability in 2027 and an additional top-three-hyperscaler deal without naming the counterparty or sizing attributable RPO. Total RPO or the number of new customers does not prove at least $3B of additional named non-OpenAI/non-UAE contracts. Silence on termination does not establish unchanged OpenAI commitments. The original positive and negative compound conditions remain incompletely observed, so unclear. Q3 2026 core revenue was $230.9M (non-GAAP; GAAP revenue $210.8M), $16.9M or 7.9% above the original $214M downside floor (derived). Core gross margin was 41% versus GAAP 20%; the measures are not interchangeable. FY2026 core revenue of $940-960M and Q4 core gross margin of 47-49% are guidance. Although above the favorable thresholds, the original test requires full-year and Q4 actuals and has not matured. The Q3 downside leg is not met and the future favorable leg remains unknown, so unclear, not completed on guidance.
change.zh: 2026-11-12 业绩稿：2026-09-30 RPO $26.1B，高于 $24.0B 下限；稿件点名 Oracle 合作（计划 2027 年提供服务），另称一项前三大 hyperscaler 合同但未具名、未给可归属 RPO 金额。不能把总 RPO 或新客户数量当作非 OpenAI/非 UAE 具名合同新增至少 $3B 的证明，也不能由稿件未谈终止推断 OpenAI 承诺未变。原正负复合腿仍未全闭合，reading=unclear。 Q3 2026 core 收入 $230.9M（非 GAAP；GAAP 收入 $210.8M），高于原 $214M 负面下限 $16.9M（+7.9%，自算）；core 毛利率 41%，GAAP 20%，不可混用。FY2026 core 收入 $940–960M 与 Q4 core 毛利率 47–49% 均为指引，虽跨过正面门槛，但原条件要求全年与 Q4 实绩，尚未成熟。因此 Q3 负面腿未触发，未来正面腿未知，reading=unclear，不把指引直接升为完成。

title.zh: CoreWeave Q3 10-Q：前二客户占收入 54%，RPO $132.3B；可取消合约负债重分类不等于退款

change.en: Note 2 of the Q3 10-Q filed November 12, 2026: for the three months ended September 30, 2026 Customer A represented 24% of revenue and Customer B 30%, with every other customer below 10%; 24%+30%=54% for the top two, below the original roughly two-thirds threshold. Nine-month A/B shares are 33%/26%, not quarterly figures. The filing explicitly warns that A-D labels may represent different customers from prior periods. Do not identify A/B as Microsoft, OpenAI or NVIDIA, or track an identical customer by letter. On this item's conjunctive trigger the concentration leg is decisively not met, so reading=within; this does not establish cancellation of NVIDIA's backstop or close circular-financing risk or other unknown legs. Note 2 of the same 10-Q reports $132.3B of unsatisfied RPO at September 30, 2026: 36% expected over the initial 24 months ending September 30, 2028, 38% in months 25-48 and the balance in months 49-86. RPO is not company-defined revenue backlog. During the quarter, $1.9B of beginning-of-period deferred revenue was reclassified to customer liabilities within other current liabilities as contracts became cancellable; that is not proof of an actual refund, cancelled order or recognized revenue. The revenue-concentration table and Note 14 related-party disclosures do not resolve the share of bookings that is supplier-backstopped/single-customer required by the original trigger. real-demand-vs-financing remains unclear; a narrowing backlog-to-quarterly-revenue ratio alone does not establish improved conversion.
change.zh: 2026-11-12 提交的 Q3 10-Q 附注 2：截至 2026-09-30 的三个月，客户 A 占收入 24%、客户 B 占 30%，其余客户均不足 10%；前两大合计 24%+30%=54%，低于原触发条件约三分之二。九个月 A/B 为 33%/26%，不得与单季混用。申报明确 A-D 标签可能代表与以前期间不同的客户，不据此把 A/B 指认为微软、OpenAI 或 NVIDIA，也不按字母追踪同一客户。按原条目合取条件，集中度腿已明确不满足，故 reading=within；这不等于证明 NVIDIA 兜底已取消，也不关闭循环融资风险或其他未知腿。 同份 10-Q 附注 2 披露 2026-09-30 未履约 RPO $132.3B，其中 36% 预计在截至 2028-09-30 的头 24 个月确认、38% 在第 25-48 个月、余量在第 49-86 个月确认；RPO 不等于公司口径 revenue backlog。季度内因合约变为可取消，期初递延收入中的 $1.9B 被重分类至其他流动负债中的客户负债；这不是已发生退款、已取消订单或已确认收入的证明。原触发条件要求的供应商兜底/单一客户订单占比仍未由这张收入集中度表或附注 14 的关联交易披露闭合，real-demand-vs-financing 维持 unclear；不能仅凭 backlog/单季收入比率收窄认定转化改善。

meaning.zh: 仅按本监测项自身触发条件记录新证据，不将已发生、计划及未知混同；历史估值边界保留。

title.en: Nebius Q3: positive GAAP operating income, but negative operating cash flow
title.zh: Nebius Q3：GAAP 经营利润转正，但经营现金流仍为负

change.en: The issuer's November 12, 2026 Q3 release reports continuing-operations revenue of $980.8M and operating costs and expenses of $930.4M: GAAP operating income is therefore $50.4M (derived, about 5.1% margin). Continuing-operations net loss was $37.5M and adjusted EBITDA $465.8M. Quarterly operating cash flow was -$273.0M, with $7,300.4M of cash purchases of property, equipment and intangible assets. Against the trigger of profit remaining driven by non-cash marks rather than operations turning positive, the quarterly GAAP operating line did turn positive, supporting within for this quarter; a net loss is not mark-driven profit. One quarter does not establish nine-month operating profitability, positive cash flow, self-funded capex or high-utilization ARR/backlog conversion. Other monitoring evidence dates are unchanged.
change.zh: 2026-11-12 发行人 Q3 业绩稿：持续经营收入 $980.8M，经营成本费用 $930.4M，故 GAAP 经营利润为 $50.4M（自算，约 5.1% 利润率）；持续经营净亏损 $37.5M、调整后 EBITDA $465.8M。季度经营现金流为 -$273.0M，购置物业设备与无形资产现金流出 $7,300.4M。严格对照“利润持续依赖非现金重估而非经营转正”，本季 GAAP 经营线已转正，故本季 reading=within；净亏损不当作重估盈利。单季改善不证明九个月整体已经营盈利，更不证明正现金流、自筹 capex 或 ARR/backlog 高利用率转化，其余监测保留各自证据日。

meaning.zh: 只对照具名监测项记录新期事实；指引不当实绩，未观测的复合腿仍保留。

title.en: NeoVolta: new $116M master agreement not identified as the original Infinite Grid LOI
title.zh: NeoVolta：新 $116M 主协议尚未与原 Infinite Grid LOI 具名对账

change.en: The November 12, 2026 release says a $116M master purchase agreement was signed, with deliveries anchoring the Georgia plant’s 2027 ramp. It does not name the buyer or explicitly connect that agreement to the original Infinite Grid 1.1GWh/$200M LOI. The consulting-agreement section of the September 30 10-Q (EDGAR filingDate November 13, accepted November 12 at 22:57:56Z) only states that no related offtake had been executed or was probable at September 30; that period-end state is not a claim of no contract in November. These two inspected documents do not provide named terms reconciling the new agreement to the original LOI, so the exact conversion condition remains unclear. A master agreement, specific orders, delivery, recognized revenue and cash collection are not interchangeable. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826008635/neovolta_i10q-093026.htm ; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826008619/neovolta_ex9901.htm
change.zh: 2026-11-12 业绩稿称已签 $116M master purchase agreement，交付将支持 Georgia 工厂 2027 年爬坡；本稿未点名买方，亦未将新协议明确对应原 Infinite Grid 1.1GWh/$200M LOI。期间截至 2026-09-30 的 10-Q（EDGAR filingDate 为 11-13、受理时间为 11-12T22:57:56Z）的顾问协议段只称在 9 月末没有已执行或很可能执行的相关 offtake，不能把期末状态外推为 11 月仍无合同。所核两份材料未提供新协议与旧 LOI 的具名条款对账，精确转换条件仍 unclear；主协议、具体订单、交付、收入确认和回款不可互换。 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826008635/neovolta_i10q-093026.htm ; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1748137/000168316826008619/neovolta_ex9901.htm

title.en: Ondas Q3: $167.5M revenue; organic growth is management-estimated and Q4 leverage remains unproven
title.zh: Ondas Q3：收入 $167.5M；同口径增长为公司估计，Q4 经营杠杆仍待验证

change.en: The November 12, 2026 release reports approximately $167.5M of Q3 revenue, above the original $140M floor, and raises the FY2026 target from $525-550M to at least $550M. Neither original adverse leg is met, so within. Company-defined backlog is $835M with $214M of new orders. Targets of more than $250M Q4 revenue and at least $1.1B FY2027 revenue are forward-looking, not recognized revenue; backlog is not GAAP RPO or immediately collectible cash. For Q3 2026 management reports 64% pro forma organic YoY growth assuming the current portfolio was owned in both periods, above the original 30% floor: within on that issuer-defined basis. It is not the roughly sixteen-fold reported-revenue comparison. The 64% is management-defined and calculated; this unit does not have independently reconstructible numerator and denominator for each acquisition cohort, and does not present it as an independently recomputed organic rate or proof of DZYNE standalone quality. Q3 2026 adjusted cash operating expense of $118.7M divided by revenue of $167.5M is approximately 70.9% (derived from rounded disclosures); adjusted EBITDA was a $59.7M loss and GAAP operating loss $189.5M. The ratio is below 80% this quarter, but the original condition explicitly names Q4 2026: Q3 does not mature that future-period test, so unclear. Management still targets Q4 platform-level EBITDA break-even and moves company-wide break-even forward to Q3 2027. Neither is achieved profit, and platform and consolidated scopes are not interchangeable.
change.zh: 2026-11-12 业绩稿：Q3 2026 收入约 $167.5M，超过原 $140M 下沿；FY2026 目标从 $525–550M 调为至少 $550M，非下调，原两条负面腿均未满足，reading=within。公司口径 backlog $835M、新订单 $214M；Q4 收入目标逾 $250M，FY2027 目标至少 $1.1B，均为前瞻而非已确认收入；backlog 不等于 GAAP RPO 或可随时回收的现金。 Q3 2026 公司称假设当前组合在两期均持有，备考同口径有机同比增长 64%，高于原 30% 下限，按该公司口径 reading=within；不是报告收入的同比 16 倍。该 64% 是管理层定义/计算的指标，本单元未取得逐收购组合的可独立重建分子与分母，因此不把它当独立核数后的有机增速，亦不用于判定 DZYNE 独立质量。 Q3 2026 调整后现金经营费用 $118.7M÷收入 $167.5M≈70.9%（按披露四舍五入数自算），调整后 EBITDA 亏损 $59.7M；GAAP 经营亏损 $189.5M。本季比率低于 80%，但原触发条件点名 Q4 2026，不能用 Q3 代替 Q4 成熟判定，故 unclear。管理层仍预计 Q4 经营平台层面 EBITDA 盈亏平衡，全公司目标提前至 Q3 2027；均不是已实现利润，且平台与全公司口径不能混用。

title.en: TSMC Q3 statutory node revenue: about 78.70% advanced-node wafer mix, not schedule or yield confirmation
title.zh: TSMC Q3 正式节点收入表：晶圆口径先进节点约 78.70%，不等于排产或良率确认

change.en: Main already contains the October 15, 2026 Q3 summary signal. This unit reconciles the November 13 statutory amounts and updates monitoring metadata still on Q2; it is not another Q3 demand-growth event. The Resolution table in the Q3 consolidated financial report furnished on Form 6-K November 13, 2026 gives Q3 wafer revenue of NT$103,129,543/396,618,245/337,110,388/123,141,757 thousand for 2nm/3nm/5nm/7nm, on NT$1,219,768,395 thousand of wafer revenue. Derived shares are about 8.45%/32.52%/27.64%/10.10%, or 78.70% at 7nm and below. These are not capacity utilization, HPC share or GPU/ASIC customer revenue; total revenue of NT$1,494,243,284 thousand is not the denominator. Mix alone does not complete the original monthly-revenue/full-year-trajectory test, so advanced-node-utilization remains unclear. The same Q3 statutory table supplies N2/N3 revenue amounts, deriving to about 8.45%/32.52% of wafer revenue. This supersedes Q2’s 3%/30% as new-period node-revenue context, but does not provide customer-by-customer schedules, yield or new-node depreciation drag. The original trigger is schedule slippage or worse-than-expected depreciation/yield, not rising revenue mix; mix cannot establish that every adverse leg is absent, so n3-n2-ramp changes from the old within to unclear, not a finding of a production setback. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1046179/000104617926000801/a2026q3consolidatedreport-.htm
change.zh: main 已有 2026-10-15 的 Q3 摘要信号；本项补录 11-13 正式附表金额，并校正报告元数据仍停留 Q2 的监测背景，不是又一次 Q3 需求增长事件。 2026-11-13 Form 6-K 所附 Q3 合并财务报告的 Resolution 表：Q3 2nm/3nm/5nm/7nm 晶圆收入分别为 NT$103,129,543/396,618,245/337,110,388/123,141,757 千元，晶圆收入分母 NT$1,219,768,395 千元。由此自算占比约 8.45%/32.52%/27.64%/10.10%，7nm 及以下合计约 78.70%。这不是产能利用率、HPC 占比或 GPU/ASIC 客户收入；不能与总收入 NT$1,494,243,284 千元混作分母。节点占比本身不完成原条件的月度收入/全年轨迹比较，advanced-node-utilization 仍 unclear。 同份 Q3 正式附表已给出 N2/N3 的收入金额，以上述晶圆收入为分母分别约 8.45%/32.52%（自算）；这取代 Q2 2nm 3%/3nm 30% 作为新期节点收入背景，但没有给出可逐客户核对的排产计划、良率或新节点折旧拖累。原 trigger 是客户排产偏离或折旧/良率超预期，不是节点收入份额上升；仅凭份额不能证明这些腿都未触发，故 n3-n2-ramp 从旧 within 改 unclear，不解释为已确认生产受挫。 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1046179/000104617926000801/a2026q3consolidatedreport-.htm

title.zh: 增长还在，但两条下调条件已经触发
title.en: Growth continues, but two downgrade conditions have fired

change.zh: 本次补入 Q3 财报后，研究重点转向增长的质量：收入同比增长 49%，同时毛利率降至 57%，订阅用户环比减少。全年调整后 EBITDA 指引也被下调。
change.en: The Q3 update shifts attention to the quality of growth: revenue rose 49% year over year, while gross margin fell to 57% and subscribers declined sequentially. Full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance was also lowered.

meaning.zh: 毛利率与订阅变化分别命中此前写下的下调条件。新事实已补入报告，但尚未据此完成估值与立场重裁；已发布的谨慎、低确信仍属于旧裁定。
meaning.en: Margin and subscriber performance each meet a previously published downgrade condition. The facts are in the report, but valuation and stance have not yet been re-adjudicated; cautious / low conviction remains the historical ruling.

next.zh: 单独复核新盈利指引与用户趋势对估值的影响，完成立场重裁。
next.en: Review the valuation implications of lower profit guidance and subscriber trends, then re-adjudicate the stance.

title.zh: 交付表现达到上行复核条件，现金转化仍待验证
title.en: Delivery clears the upside review threshold; cash conversion still needs proof

change.zh: Q3 收入和毛利率同时超过报告预设的上行复核门槛。单季经营现金流转正，在手订单扩大；但扣除资本开支后，单季现金流仍为负。
change.en: Q3 revenue and gross margin both exceeded the report’s thresholds for an upside review. Quarterly operating cash flow turned positive and backlog grew, but cash flow after capital spending remained negative.

meaning.zh: 本次更新提供了重建上行情景的依据，还没有形成新的估值结论。Neutron 首飞仍以不早于 2027 年为目标，与此前披露一致，不应写成又一次延期。
meaning.en: The update provides grounds to rebuild the upside scenario, without establishing a new valuation conclusion. Neutron still targets no earlier than 2027, consistent with prior disclosure rather than another delay.

next.zh: 重建上行情景，并用完整下半年数据检验现金与订单质量。
next.en: Rebuild the upside scenario and use full second-half results to assess cash generation and backlog quality.

title.zh: 资产出售改变了下一轮估值需要回答的问题
title.en: The planned asset sale changes the questions for the next valuation review

change.zh: 报告补入 Q3 业绩、首次发布的 2027 年指引，以及以 40 亿美元出售 4.9GW 燃气电厂的计划。公司同时披露回购与交割后减债安排。
change.en: The report adds Q3 results, initial 2027 guidance and a plan to sell 4.9GW of gas plants for $4 billion, alongside buyback and post-closing debt-reduction plans.

meaning.zh: 后续估值需要同时考虑售出资产的盈利贡献、出售所得与资本分配。交易目标为 2027 年第二季度交割且仍待审批；已公布的 2027 年指引尚未计入此次出售。
meaning.en: The next valuation must consider earnings leaving with the assets, sale proceeds and capital allocation together. Closing is targeted for Q2 2027 and remains subject to approvals; published 2027 guidance excludes the sale.

next.zh: 核实审批与交割进展，并在独立估值复核中重算出售后的盈利和债务。
next.en: Track approvals and closing, then rebuild post-sale earnings and debt in a separate valuation review.

title.zh: 盈利指引收窄，收购与融资承诺仍有待落地
title.en: Earnings guidance narrows while acquisition and financing remain conditional

change.zh: 本次补入 Q3 业绩、收窄后的全年盈利指引，以及拟收购 RISEC 的进展。报告同时更新债务事实与 DOE 担保的条件边界。
change.en: This update adds Q3 results, a narrower full-year earnings range and the proposed RISEC acquisition, together with debt facts and the conditions attached to the DOE guarantee.

meaning.zh: 拟议收购仍待批准，DOE 至多 50 亿美元担保也只是有条件承诺。两者都不能直接当作已完成交易或已到位资金计入新的估值结论。
meaning.en: The acquisition still awaits approval and the DOE guarantee of up to $5 billion is a conditional commitment. Neither establishes a completed transaction or funding already received for a new valuation conclusion.

next.zh: 跟踪交易审批与融资条件，并在估值重算时统一处理债务及新指引。
next.en: Track approvals and financing conditions, then reconcile debt and new guidance in a valuation rebuild.

title.zh: 重新估值后，从谨慎调整为中性观察
title.en: A rebuilt valuation moves the stance from cautious to neutral-watch

change.zh: 按 10 月 30 日收盘价重建估值，并纳入 Q3 业绩、Q4 指引及通美私募影响。立场由谨慎、中确信调整为中性观察、低确信。
change.en: Valuation was rebuilt at the October 30 close using Q3 results, Q4 guidance and the Tongmei placement. The stance moves from cautious / medium to neutral-watch / low conviction.

meaning.zh: 这次调整来自价格与情景分布的变化，并非此前的上调条件已经触发。重建后的牛熊分布大致对称，加权年化回报仍低于要求门槛，因此没有转为偏多。
meaning.en: The change is driven by price and the scenario distribution, rather than a previously published upgrade condition firing. Bull and bear outcomes are roughly symmetric, while the weighted annualized return remains below the hurdle, so the stance does not become constructive.

next.zh: 继续核实 Q3 10-Q、出口许可与私募交割条件；相关未知项仍限制确信度。
next.en: Verify the Q3 10-Q, export permits and placement closing conditions; unresolved items continue to limit conviction.
